runner: run_experiments.py --holdout -> tests/live_claude_v7.cjs (headless-node, command line; report separately from browser runs)
source: user local machine, batch-20261015-154647 (seed 2026), -161810 (3140), -165312 (8675), run one after another; all runs report commit 5e37851 with clean source/tests
device: VLAB-X (held out: CoreXY belts with backlash, Modbus-RTU style registers with CRC-16; not used in development)
freeze: System frozen at E after the E-version P2 runs (PR #23). These results did not and must not change the gate, prompts, reference module or thresholds.

baseline.note: ratioToBaseline = live actions / offline reference control module actions on the same seed

notes: All nine runs 5/5 with simulator truth (45/45 trials); no control failures, no interruptions; two transient retries absorbed; zero unconfirmed actuations.
Each controller was replayed offline over five trials on all three seeds: 27/27 complete; own-seed replays reproduce the live action counts exactly.
Live actions 151-182, ratio to the offline reference module 0.91-1.10 (median 0.98).

Driver: 8/9 passed the Modbus driver test first time (CRC, unit address, exception replies, silent device); x-s3140-r3 failed twice on the lift/grip encode/decode case, then passed. driverRuntime.programErrors = 8 per passed driver test is the expected count of throws on the eight malformed reply fixtures, not a runtime fault.

Controller: 4/9 passed the isolation gate first time; 17 gate runs in total. The most common rejection was the boundary-start case (5 runs). The manual describes linear motor channels, so the two rotary-only two-link cases were report-only on this device; they appear in some failure lists but did not decide pass/fail.
Host performs the enable/home startup in handshake; the model did not perform the homing procedure.

Validity limits: one model, 3 seeds x 3 repeats; CoreXY with backlash is a constant linear channel mix plus a dead zone, i.e. kinematically within the class the linear isolation cases already cover. The new element for the model is mainly the protocol family (Modbus-RTU style, CRC-16) and the coupled belts, not a new kinematic class.
